headline: 61 contract roles catalogued across 60+ chains; canonical EndpointV2 0x1a440... deployed uniformly; GitHub and audit repos discovered; on-chain reads blocked by fetch limit.

findings.text: D1: Block-explorer name-tag search not directly executed (fetch limit constraints). Addresses extracted from official metadata API which is the authoritative source per docs page. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, BSC, Optimism, zkSync Era, Linea, Scroll, Blast, Mode, Sonic, Celo, Fantom, Metis, Berachain, Soneium, Unichain, Katana, and 40+ additional mainnet chains confirmed. Etherscan explorer URL confirmed in metadata for ethereum chain.

D2: Official deployments doc located at https://docs.layerzero.network/v2/deployments/deployed-contracts. Dynamically rendered from https://metadata.layerzero-api.com/v1/metadata/deployments. Per-chain pages also exist at /v2/deployments/chains/{chainkey}. Key contracts per chain: EndpointV2, SendUln302, ReceiveUln302, ReadLib1002, LZ Executor, Dead DVN, Blocked Message Library. Canonical EndpointV2 address 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fE728c is identical across all surveyed mainnet EVM chains — confirmed from metadata API response.

D3: No audit PDFs linked directly in protocol.audit_links. However, GitHub audit repo discovered at https://github.com/LayerZero-Labs/Audits via search. Code4rena audit competition repos found: code-423n4/2025-09-layerzero and code-423n4/2026-04-layerzero. An OtterSec audit for WAB V2 dated September 2024 was surfaced. Previous audits reference in c4 contest: https://github.com/LayerZero-Labs/Audits. Specific PDFs require additional fetches not possible in this run.

D4: GitHub repo confirmed as https://github.com/LayerZero-Labs/LayerZero-v2 from both the official website footer and search results. README confirms /protocol directory has immutable Endpoint interfaces, /messagelib has append-only MessageLibs. No pinned commit SHA available in this run; SHA not pinned per rule. Additional address-book repo: https://github.com/LayerZero-Labs/lz-address-book.

D5: Multi-chain enumeration executed via metadata API covering all protocol.chains. Key V2 EVM endpoints for referenced chains: Ethereum eid=30101, Base eid=30184, Arbitrum eid=30110, Polygon eid=30109, Avalanche eid=30106, BNB eid=30102, Optimism eid=30111, zkSync Era eid=30165, Linea eid=30183, Scroll eid=30214, Blast eid=30243, Mode eid=30260, Sonic eid=30332, Celo eid=30125, Fantom eid=30112, Metis eid=30151, Berachain eid=30362, Soneium eid=30340, Unichain eid=30320, Katana eid=30375, Moonriver eid=30167, Harmony eid=30116, Hedera eid=30316, Tempo eid=30410, World Chain eid=30319, Morph eid=30322, Nibiru eid=30369, Monad eid=30390, xDai (Gnosis) eid=30145, Plume Mainnet eid=30370 (plumephoenix), Kava eid=30177, Lisk eid=30321, Taiko eid=30290, Swellchain eid=30335, Abstract eid=30324, Flare eid=30295, Fraxtal eid=30255, Hyperliquid eid=30367, Mantle eid=30181, Astar eid=30210, Peaq eid=30302, Ink eid=30339, BOB eid=30279, Flow eid=30336, Klaytn eid=30150, Citrea eid=30403, Conflux eid=30212, OpBNB eid=30202, XDC eid=30365, Sei eid=30280, TAC eid=30377, RSK (Rootstock) eid=30333.

D6: No factory pattern identified in LayerZero V2 core architecture. The protocol deploys fixed singleton contracts (EndpointV2, MessageLibs, Executor) per chain rather than factory-spawned children. OApp/OFT deployments by third parties are user-deployed and out of scope for this registry.

D7: Role taxonomy applied. EndpointV2 = other (core protocol singleton); SendUln302 = other (message library, append-only); ReceiveUln302 = other (message library, append-only); ReadLib1002 = other (read message library); LZ Executor = other (off-chain execution relay contract); Dead DVN = other (placeholder DVN address); Blocked Message Library = other (pathway disable contract). No governance token, multisig, or timelock identified from available data — upgradeability claimed as immutable in docs but not on-chain verified this run.

D8: All addresses in admin_addresses traced to the metadata API fetch (https://metadata.layerzero-api.com/v1/metadata/deployments) confirmed in this run. Cross-chain address consistency confirmed: EndpointV2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fE728c appears in ethereum-mainnet, base-mainnet, arbitrum-mainnet, polygon-mainnet, avalanche-mainnet, bsc-mainnet, optimism-mainnet, blast-mainnet, scroll-mainnet, linea-mainnet, celo-mainnet, fantom-mainnet, mantle-mainnet and dozens more chains.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked official docs, metadata API, website, and GitHub. The metadata API (fetched this run) returned the canonical address registry for all 60+ chains. The EndpointV2 at 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fE728c is uniformly deployed across virtually all mainnet EVM chains. Per-chain MessageLib and Executor addresses vary. No admin/multisig/governance/timelock contracts were surfaced from available data — upgradeability/control surface assessment deferred to control slice. Grade is unknown as this is a discovery slice.

protocol_metadata.about: LayerZero V2 is an immutable omnichain messaging protocol that enables smart contracts on different blockchains to send arbitrary data, tokens, and external calls to each other. Developers deploy OApp (Omnichain Application) or OFT (Omnichain Fungible Token) contracts which interface with the canonical EndpointV2 singleton, specifying Decentralized Verifier Networks (DVNs) for message verification security. The protocol spans 60+ EVM and non-EVM chains with a uniform canonical EndpointV2 at 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fE728c on most EVM mainnets, making cross-chain messaging available through a single interface with configurable security via pluggable DVN and Executor components.
